attack vector security.title: Adversarial WASM Parser Input
attack vector security.content: Malformed WASM or oversized inputs to parser could crash or hang runtime. Mitigation: Cycle 6 adversarial attack surface audit; fuzz command (1000 iterations); SHA-3 final hash.

attack vector security.title: Self-Mutating Grammar Drift
attack vector security.content: Runtime grammar mutations could introduce ambiguous or unreachable constructs. Mitigation: Version bumping on mutation; mutation log; feature_matrix_v2.json orthogonality checks.

attack vector security.title: IPFS Gateway SSRF
attack vector security.content: Malicious import paths could target internal network via IPFS gateway fetch. Mitigation: CID validation; 10s timeout; ipfs:// prefix enforcement; content hash verification.

attack vector security.title: Post-Quantum Signature Forgery
attack vector security.content: Forged PQ signatures on AST artifacts could bypass integrity checks. Mitigation: Dilithium3 (NIST PQC finalist) sign/verify on canonical AST bytes.

attack vector security.title: ZK-SNARK Proof Bypass
attack vector security.content: Invalid Groth16 proofs could allow unverified AST to pass verification. Mitigation: arkworks Groth16 BN254; AST hash commitment circuit; proof deserialization validation.
